title: Code mode on by default
note: Owner decision, 2026-10-20: codemode is a Bake default tool. Base is develop at bf32369ca6, where codemode is opt-in; candidate is 17ddacbb4f, which adds it to BAKE_DEFAULT_TOOL_NAMES. Both arms run their default tools, on the standard suite and fan_out, with the newest model of each gateway lab plus DeepSeek two, three trials. Every request carries about 2.1 KB more tool definitions (toolSchemaChars 4692-4860 to 6823-7004). Models that used it: claude-opus-5 (21 calls in 11 of 27 samples; requests -7.9%, tool calls 107 to 79, tokens +6.5% with an interval spanning zero), gpt-6-sol (16 calls in 9 of 27; requests -10.2%, tool calls 116 to 77, tokens -5.5%), gemini-3-flash (4 calls) and gemini-3.5-flash-lite (2 calls). claude-sonnet-5, deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, and kimi-k2.7-code never called it. Accepted regressions, all from the definition in requests the model never used it in, accepted because the owner chose the default: claude-sonnet-5 +18.9%, deepseek-flash +17.2%, deepseek-v4-pro +17.0%, kimi-k2.7-code +59.1%. Kimi rises 12-41% on the standard scenarios; its fan_out +154% is its approach, not the tool: the candidate printed every ledger through bash in fewer requests (19 to 14) where the base read one or two and summed them with a script. gemini-3-flash tool errors 24 to 26 are git and node checks run outside a repository, as in the base. The one failure, claude-sonnet-5 fan_out trial 2 in the candidate, wrote correct balances but then ran mv balances.txt ../balances.txt, assuming an earlier cd persisted between bash calls, which moved the file out of the workspace; it made no codemode call.

settings.effort: each route's effort is in routes: medium by default, DeepSeek high (it has no medium), and an EVAL_MODELS @<effort> replaces either

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
